Saved in this browser. Saving an event is not an RSVP.

A field guide, not a crystal ball.

Full descriptions are retained from October 7 unless later supplied. Always check each host for current time, exact venue and admission. Unknown end times remain unknown and are excluded from timed day plans.

Municipalities use the recorded city field, with unincorporated communities labeled separately. Elsewhere includes other published places and events without a resolved municipality; virtual events have their own option. A published address can supply a place label without inventing map coordinates. Los Angeles neighborhoods have their own filter. Coordinates can be approximate addresses, neighborhood centers or municipality centers. ZIP searches use Zippopotam.us and approximate straight-line distances, not travel times or exact venue ZIP matches.

Plans stay in this browser. Sharing includes only selected public event IDs. No account or automatic RSVP.
